name: agentid-extension
description: Browser extension to verify AgentID hashes

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p dist/popup && cp src/popup/*.html src/popup/*.css dist/popup/ && cp -r icons dist/ && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp src/content.css dist/
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../agentid-extension.zip .
